crime_description: Faking an archeological discovery of an ancient curse to crash local real estate prices. Interrogators should probe for connections to an insider, a hidden agenda, remote coordination, hidden assets, and an elaborate escape plan.

suspect.name: Lucius Murphy
suspect.fake_alibi: Lucius claims he was attending a high-society charity gala in Paris, surrounded by hundreds of witnesses.

secrets.value: Marcel, the disgruntled head groundskeeper who mixed the defoliant into the irrigation system.
Lucius wanted to ruin Dubois's harvest so he could acquire the historic estate at a bankruptcy auction.
was actively coordinating the crime from a secure burner phone
untraceable offshore account holding the illicit funds
chartered a private flight under a fake identity
